data.one_liner: Provides widgets that emulate CSS position: sticky in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: StickyContainer and StickyWidget let a child widget stay fixed at a position while scrolling until a threshold. They use a shared ScrollController to track scroll offset and reposition the widget between initial and final positions.
use_when: Implement sticky headers or footers in a list
Create floating action buttons that stick after scrolling
Need a simple, platform‑agnostic sticky UI pattern
avoid_when: Complex nested scroll views that require independent controllers
Performance‑critical apps where every frame must be ultra‑fast
Scenarios needing custom scroll physics beyond basic offset tracking
strengths: Works on all Flutter platforms (web, mobile, desktop)
weaknesses: Requires a single ScrollController shared with the scrollable
No built‑in support for nested or multi‑axis scrolling
